name: clone-website
description: Reverse-engineer and clone any website as a pixel-perfect replica
prompt: # Clone Website Rebuild **the target URL provided by the user** as pixel-perfect Next.js 16 clones (App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui; follow `AGENTS.md`). Several URLs: process each independently, artifacts isolated per host (`docs/research//`, `docs/design-references//`). You are the foreman: measure a section, write its spec, hand it to a builder in a worktree, move on to the next section while it builds. Extraction is done by scripts that return compact JSON, never by eyeballing screenshots or dumping DOM/HTML into context. **Defaults** (user instructions override): pixel-perfect, pure emulation, real content and assets, responsive, mock data for dynamic parts. Out of scope: backend, auth, real-time, SEO, a11y audit. ## Toolkit (`scripts/clone/`) All commands run headless Chrome over CDP, write full JSON to `docs/research//`, screenshots to `docs/design-references//`, and print only a short summary. Read the JSON file only for the keys you need. | Command | Gives you | |---|---| | `node scripts/clone/inspect.mjs recon --w=1440,390` | topology (sections in order, sticky/fixed), layers (z-index), tokens (colors, type scale incl. font-feature-settings, radii, shadows, spacing, `:root` vars), fonts + `@font-face` files/weights/unicode-range, CSS breakpoints, `@keyframes`, libs (Lenis, GSAP, Swiper…), IntersectionObserver/scroll-listener hooks, assets (img currentSrc/srcset/sizes/``, backgrounds incl. pseudo-elements, videos, icons, meta), one screenshot per section | | `inspect.mjs section [name] --w=1440,768,390` | style tree: only non-default computed values (inherited values omitted when equal to parent), box rect `r:[x,y,w,h]`, own text, key attrs, `::before/::after`, identical siblings collapsed into `rep`, deduped SVGs, running animations; clipped screenshot per width | | `inspect.mjs states ` | for every control in ``: diffs under forced `:hover`, `:focus-visible`, `:active`, plus real-pointer hover diffs (JS menus/tooltips), and its `transition` | | `inspect.mjs scroll [0,120,600]` | style diff of `` subtree at each scroll y (sticky headers, scroll-triggered classes) | | `inspect.mjs responsive ` | layout-only diffs at 1440/1024/768/390 + CSS breakpoints → exact switch points | | `inspect.mjs shot [name]` | clipped screenshot only | | `node scripts/clone/download.mjs docs/research//recon.json` | downloads images (largest srcset candidate; `--all-srcset` for all), backgrounds, videos/posters, woff2 fonts, icons/OG → `public/`; writes `assets-map.json` (remote → local path) | | `node scripts/clone/diff.mjs [sel] [--clone-sel=..] --w=1440,390` | pixel mismatch %, height delta, hot y-bands, diff PNG, and a text-anchored style diff (font family/size/weight/line-height/letter-spacing/color/position per text string). Exit 2 if mismatch > `--max` (3%) | Flags: `--w=` widths, `--settle=ms` wait after load, `--headed` if a bot wall blocks headless, `--depth=` tree depth, `--out=` dir. Fallback when Chrome automation is impossible: paste `scripts/clone/extract.js` into the browser-MCP JS tool once per page load, then call `JSON.stringify(__cx.section(''))`, `__cx.tokens()`, `__cx.cssRules()` (same-origin sheets only), etc. Use the browser MCP only for what scripts can't judge: watching time-driven motion, carousels, video, and confirming feel. ## Non-negotiables 1. **Measured, never guessed.** Every value in a spec comes from the JSON. `text-lg` is wrong if the site's line-height is 24px. 2. **Interaction model first.** For each interactive section decide: static, click, hover, scroll, or time driven. Run `scroll` before clicking anything; IO hooks in recon plus a scroll diff mean scroll-driven. Building click tabs for a scroll-driven section is a rewrite. 3. **Every state.** Hover/focus/active (`states`), scrolled (`scroll`), each tab/slide (click via MCP, then `section` again or `__cx.section`), each breakpoint (`responsive`). 4. **Spec before dispatch.** One spec file per builder in `docs/research//components/.spec.md`. 5. **Small tasks.** A spec over ~120 lines, or a section with 3+ distinct sub-components → split it (one builder per sub-component, then a wrapper builder). 6. **Real assets, all layers.** Enumerate every ``, background (including `::before/::after`), and video in the section's tree. Check for video, canvas, or Lottie before building a mockup of something animated. 7. **Always compiles.** Builders pass `npx tsc --noEmit`; you pass `npm run build` after every merge. ## Phase 0: Pre-flight 1. Validate each URL; `npm run build` must pass on the scaffold. 2. Run `recon` (1440, 390). If it is blocked or returns an empty topology, retry with `--headed`, then fall back to browser MCP + `extract.js`. ## Phase 1: Recon → two short docs From the recon summary and JSON write: - `PAGE_TOPOLOGY.md`: sections in order as `s0 | name | static/click/scroll/time | sticky? z | height`, plus page-level layout (scroll container, overlays, z-index order from `layers`). - `BEHAVIORS.md`: one line per behavior: trigger → change → timing. Sources: `scroll` on the header and any sticky/fixed layer, `hooks.io` (rootMargin/threshold → reveal animations), `animations` and `keyframes`, `libs` (Lenis: replicate smooth scroll), auto-advancing content (watch 10s in MCP). ## Phase 2: Foundation (you, sequential) Read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/font.md` first. 1. `download.mjs` → assets and fonts in `public/`. 2. **Fonts:** `next/font/local` with each downloaded face's exact `weight`/`style` (variable range as `"400 700"`), `display` from `@font-face`, and a CSS variable. Keep subsetting: one face per `unicode-range` file actually used. Apply recorded `font-feature-settings`/`font-variation-settings`, `-webkit-font-smoothing`, and `text-rendering` globally or per element as measured. Google-hosted → `next/font/google` with exact weights. 3. **Tokens** in `src/app/globals.css`: map measured colors to shadcn variables in `:root` (and `.dark` if themed), add the type scale, radii, shadows and the site's `:root` vars, and expose them via `@theme inline`. Copy the `@keyframes` verbatim. Add global scroll behavior (Lenis, `scroll-behavior`, snap). 4. **Icons:** convert the deduped `svgs` from section JSONs into named components in `src/components/icons.tsx` (name by function; `currentColor` where the source uses it; keep `viewBox`). 5. Content types in `src/types/`. `npm run build`. ## Phase 3: Per section — extract → spec → dispatch (top to bottom, don't wait) **Extract** (only what the section needs): ``` inspect.mjs section "" --w=1440,768,390 inspect.mjs states "" # if it has controls inspect.mjs scroll "" # if sticky/fixed or BEHAVIORS lists a scroll trigger inspect.mjs responsive "" # if the 768/390 trees differ structurally ``` For click/time states: trigger each via MCP, re-run `__cx.section` and record per-state content. **Spec** (`components/.spec.md`). Keep it terse and fill every heading, `N/A` only when truly none: ```markdown # → src/components/.tsx Shot: docs/design-references//-{1440,768,390}.png Model: static | click | hover | scroll | time — ## Structure ## Styles (exact; px→Tailwind only when identical, else arbitrary values) : ← copy from section JSON `css`; r gives box size ## States hover: bg #0a7cff→#005bd1 · transition background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) focus-visible: outline 2px solid #000, offset 2px scrolled (y>50): box-shadow none→0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2) · 300ms ease ## Responsive ≤768 (max-width:768px): grid 3→1 cols; h2 40/60→28/42 ## Assets img: /images//hero.jpg (srcset 1x/2x → next/image sizes="100vw"), icons: CartIcon ## Content (verbatim, per state) ``` **Dispatch** a builder agent (`frontend-developer` if installed, else general-purpose) in its own worktree. Brief = target file + spec path + screenshot paths + this contract: > Read only the spec and screenshots listed. Build `` as a named export, TypeScript strict, Tailwind classes only (arbitrary values like `text-[17px] leading-[24px] tracking-[-0.2px]` when no exact token exists; never round), `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`, icons from `@/components/icons`, assets from the listed `/public` paths. Reproduce every listed state with the exact transition property, duration, easing and delay; `motion-safe:` only if the source respects reduced motion. Use mobile-first breakpoints at the spec's exact px (`max-[768px]:`/`min-[1024px]:` arbitrary variants when they aren't Tailwind defaults). Keep z-index and sticky offsets as specified. `` with `srcset/sizes` or `next/image` with matching `sizes`; preserve `object-fit/position`. Finish with `npx tsc --noEmit` passing, commit, and report deviations. Then extract the next section immediately. **Merge** finished worktrees as they land, resolve conflicts with your full context, `npm run build` after each. ## Phase 4: Assembly Wire sections into `src/app/page.tsx` per `PAGE_TOPOLOGY.md`: page-level layout, overlay/sticky z-order, page behaviors (smooth scroll, scroll-driven reveals, theme switches). `npm run build`. ## Phase 5: Verify by diff, not by eye Run `npm run dev`, then per section (and `body`): ``` node scripts/clone/diff.mjs http://localhost:3000 "" --clone-sel="" --w=1440,768,390 ``` Fix in this order: height delta and missing text (structure) → text style issues (font, size, line-height, tracking, color) → hot bands (open that crop of the diff PNG only). If a spec value was wrong, re-extract and update the spec. Loop until each section is ≤3% mismatch (live/rotating content excepted, noted) and text issues are 0. Then check behaviors from `BEHAVIORS.md` in the browser (hover, scroll triggers, tabs, carousels, smooth scroll). Optionally hand the diff reports to an `evidence-collector` agent for an independent pass. ## Gotchas - Lazy/animated content: scripts set `loading=eager` and diff freezes motion. Raise `--settle` for slow hero media. - Sticky/fixed elements show in many section shots. Diff them separately and clip around them. - Pseudo-element backgrounds and overlay `` layers are the most-missed assets. - Equal grid tracks print as `repeat(n, 1fr)`. Confirm fixed vs fluid in the 1024 vs 1440 `responsive` diff. - `rep` entries share the first sibling's styles. Only their text/href/src differ. - Bot walls (Akamai etc.): `--headed`, or the MCP fallback. Never solve CAPTCHAs. ## Completion report Sections built, components and specs (counts should match), assets downloaded (images/videos/fonts/SVGs), `npm run build` result, the per-section diff table (mismatch % at each width and text issues), and known gaps.
